import numpy as np
from scipy.constants import hbar, eV, Bohr
import pennylane as qml
import qiskit
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile
from qiskit.circuit.library.qubit_operations import H, CX, RX
from qiskit.circuit.parameter import Parameter, UniformQubitParameter
from qiskit.transpile import pass_through
from qiskit.compiler import assemble, assemble_qobj, transpile
from qiskit.visualization import plot_histogram
from qiskit.aer.backends import AerSimulator, QasmSimulator
from qiskit_nature.drivers import FockSpaceDriver
from qiskit_nature. Hamiltonians import FockSpaceHamiltonian
from qiskit_nature.drivers.molecular_dynamics.geometry import MolecularGeometry
from qiskit_nature.drivers.molecular_dynamics.basis_sets import StoGBasisSet

# Geometry in Bohr and Angstrom units
geometry = MolecularGeometry.from_cartesian([[0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 1.5957 * Bohr]])
basis = StoGBasisSet.from_molecule(geometry)
hamiltonian = FockSpaceHamiltonian(basis, frozen_core=True, active_space_size=6)

# Define the VQE ansatz
n_qubits = hamiltonian.n_qubits
ansatz = qml.qc.QubitQNode(qml.QFT(n_qubits), device='qubit', interface='qiskit', wires=list(range(n_qubits)))

# Parameter bounds and optimization settings
params = [Parameter("p_%i" % i, -np.pi, np.pi) for i in range(n_qubits)]
optimizer = qml.gradient_ascent_pso(maxiter=1000, learning_rate=0.5, inertia=0.7)

# VQE function
def vqe_LiH_STO3G_frozen_core(hamiltonian, ansatz, params, optimizer, num_shots=1000):
    qc = ansatz.qc()
    bind_params(qc, params)
    qobj = assemble(qc)
    transpiled_qobj = transpile(qobj, AerSimulator())
    energy = transpiled_qobj.data["result"].real
    gradients = qml.gradient(energy, params)
    opt_result = optimizer.minimize(lambda p: energy, params)
    return {
        "ground_state_energy_estimate": energy,
        "energy_error_against_reference": energy - hamiltonian.e_0,
        "chemical_accuracy_achievement": np.abs((energy - hamiltonian.e_0) / hamiltonian.e_0),
        "measurement_cost": num_shots,
        "qubit_count": qc.num_qubits,
        "circuit_depth": qc.depth(),
        "gate_count": qc.num_ops(),
    }

# Execute VQE and print results
result = vqe_LiH_STO3G_frozen_core(hamiltonian, ansatz, params, optimizer)
print(result)

```python
import numpy as np
from scipy.constants import hbar, eV, Bohr
import pennylane as qml
import qiskit
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile
from qiskit.circuit.library.qubit_operations import H, CX, RX
from qiskit.circuit.parameter import Parameter, UniformQubitParameter
from qiskit.transpile import pass_through
from qiskit.compiler import assemble, assemble_qobj, transpile
from qiskit.visualization import plot_histogram
from qiskit.aer.backends import AerSimulator, QasmSimulator
from qiskit_nature.drivers import FockSpaceDriver
from qiskit_nature. Hamiltonians import FockSpaceHamiltonian
from qiskit_nature.drivers.molecular_dynamics.geometry import MolecularGeometry
from qiskit_nature.drivers.molecular_dynamics.basis_sets import StoGBasisSet

# Geometry in Bohr and Angstrom units
geometry = MolecularGeometry.from_cartesian([[0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 1.5957 * Bohr]])
basis = StoGBasisSet.from_molecule(geometry)
hamiltonian = FockSpaceHamiltonian(basis, frozen_core=True, active_space_size=6)

# Define the VQE ansatz
n_qubits = hamiltonian.n_qubits
ansatz = qml.qc.QubitQNode(qml.QFT(n_qubits), device='qubit', interface='qiskit', wires=list(range(n_qubits)))

# Parameter bounds and optimization settings
params = [Parameter("p_%i" % i, -np.pi, np.pi) for i in range(n_qubits)]
optimizer = qml.gradient_ascent_pso(maxiter=1000, learning_rate=0.5, inertia=0.7)

# VQE function
def vqe_LiH_STO3G_frozen_core(hamiltonian, ansatz, params, optimizer, num_shots=1000):
    qc = ansatz.qc()
    bind_params(qc, params)
    qobj = assemble(qc)
    transpiled_qobj = transpile(qobj, AerSimulator())
    energy = transpiled_qobj.data["result"].real
    gradients = qml.gradient(energy, params)
    opt_result = optimizer.minimize(lambda p: energy, params)
    return {
        "ground_state_energy_estimate": energy,
        "energy_error_against_reference": energy - hamiltonian.e_0,
        "chemical_accuracy_achievement": np.abs((energy - hamiltonian.e_0) / hamiltonian.e_0),
        "measurement_cost": num_shots,
        "qubit_count": qc.num_qubits,
        "circuit_depth": qc.depth(),
        "gate_count": qc.num_ops(),
    }

# Execute VQE and print results
result = vqe_LiH_STO3G_frozen_core(hamiltonian, ansatz, params, optimizer)
print(result)
```
